desc:
Engage in incredible fights and recreate fights from the original series in DRAGON BALL R! Explore a vast world, meet new foes and aim to become the strongest!

In-development movesets require the "Early Access" gamepass to use.

You can challenge other players to a duel by typing "!1v1 username" in chat!

Private server commands:
!nocooldowns username
!cooldowns username (reverts !nocooldowns)
!kill username
!kick username
!serverban username
